items.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He would play at some joints. I‘d go there and sit in with him

ctx.x: Yeah. He‘s my daughter‘s godfather, and he‘s a very close friend of my family, and I used to go to all the joints, you know. He would play at some joints. I‘d go there and sit in with him, cut the foo [phonetic] and all. But maybe twenty gigs I played organ, when I wasn‘t just fooling around, you know. But after you get a little bit of that organ in you, you‘ve got to get back to the piano. You‘ve got to come on home. I do it sometimes now for kicks.
Did you ever record on organ?
